title: Kotlin first, for JVM, Android and Node
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second; Stakeholder directive: transpile targets and API-first.

statements.label: Kotlin first, for JVM, Android and Node
statements.requirement: The first implementation SHALL be a Kotlin Multiplatform library with all pipeline logic in common code. It SHALL ship for three targets: JVM (Java 11+), Android, and Node.js (Kotlin/JS IR, published to npm with an @JsExport facade and generated TypeScript declarations). Other KMP targets MAY follow.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-GEN-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: node-smoke.mjs; `STT-SEC-002 STT-GEN-004 cryptography comes from the platform, with no third-party runtime dependency` (ArchitectureTest.kt)).
